shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A woman in a green shirt sits at the pinboard-side window seat and asks to restart the detailed account, while a man in an orange shirt sits at the entrance-side window seat, a man in a white shirt sits at the pinboard-side aisle seat, and a man in a blue shirt sits at the entrance-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the entrance end, looking along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the pinboard in frame.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt asks about the initial evidence, and a woman in a green shirt explains the sequence.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a green shirt summarizes the remaining questions about the account.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the pinboard-side window seat.

shots.content: A man in a white shirt asks for more detail on the evidence, a woman in a green shirt answers, and a man in an orange shirt replies.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the worktable.
